derivation_source: scripts.qbank.option_set_admissibility.RESPONSE_CLASS_AXES + scripts.qbank.chapter_staged_generation.DECISION_GRANULARITIES (both pre-existing closed vocabularies; no new tokens invented)
root_cause: SEMANTICS_EXIST_BUT_NOT_ON_OPPORTUNITY_LAYER (response_class axis closed and code-enforced in scripts/qbank/contrast_supply.py::library_eligible_candidates; decision_granularity closed enum exists in a different, unwired module -- chapter_staged_generation.DECISION_GRANULARITIES -- and was never bridged to the Development-12 opportunity records)
candidate_discovery_visibility: NONE -- authored from learner_decision text only, before any candidate/distractor supply was consulted

opportunities.learner_decision: Recognize a severe COPD exacerbation with acute respiratory failure and urgently escalate care.
opportunities.justification: The decision is a single immediate action -- urgently escalate care for respiratory failure -- not a choice among diagnoses or a full management plan.

opportunities.learner_decision: For intermittent palpitations, seek ECG documentation or symptom-rhythm correlation rather than diagnosing an arrhythmia from symptoms alone.
opportunities.justification: ECG/symptom-rhythm correlation for intermittent palpitations is rhythm documentation over time (ambulatory/event monitoring), not a one-off structural or biochemical test; the decision is which single diagnostic step to pursue next.

independent_review.response_class_reason: ECG documentation and prolonged rhythm correlation are two textually offered paths of different investigation_purpose character (FUNCTIONAL vs MONITORING); MONITORING is defensible but not uniquely forced by the decision text.

opportunities.learner_decision: In a child with acute gastroenteritis and mild-to-moderate dehydration, use oral rehydration solution as initial rehydration when oral intake is safe.
opportunities.justification: Choosing oral rehydration over IV fluids is a step on the least-invasive end of the same support-escalation ladder next_action_class already uses for respiratory support (LOW_FLOW/HIGH_FLOW); no dedicated rehydration token exists so MINIMAL_SUPPORT is the closest textually-supported fit. FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW: weakest mapping in this set.

independent_review.response_class_reason: MINIMAL_SUPPORT is a token from the respiratory support-escalation ladder (paired with LOW_FLOW_SUPPORT/HIGH_FLOW_SUPPORT); reusing it for enteral-vs-parenteral rehydration route selection overloads it outside its evident physiological domain. No existing token in any axis covers fluid-route selection; this is a genuine vocabulary gap, not a reviewer-resolvable ambiguity.

opportunities.learner_decision: In a child with polyuria, polydipsia, and weight loss, immediately check glucose and ketones and urgently assess for diabetic ketoacidosis.
opportunities.justification: The stated decision is the immediate order to check glucose/ketones, not the eventual DKA management plan.

opportunities.learner_decision: When pelvic inflammatory disease is clinically suspected, test for pregnancy and relevant infections and begin empiric broad-spectrum treatment without waiting for perfect diagnostic certainty.
opportunities.justification: Empiric broad-spectrum antibiotic coverage for suspected PID is definitionally a multi-agent treatment bundle started pending further workup, not a single-drug order.

opportunities.learner_decision: For pain or bleeding in early pregnancy, obtain transvaginal ultrasound and serum beta-hCG and continue follow-up until pregnancy location is established.
opportunities.justification: The decision's own end-state is anatomic pregnancy localization (transvaginal ultrasound); serial beta-hCG is adjunctive to that structural question rather than the primary purpose.

independent_review.decision_granularity_reason: The decision names two investigations plus ongoing follow-up until resolution, not a single discrete test; DECISION_GRANULARITIES has no multi-step diagnostic-pathway token, so forcing DIAGNOSTIC_TEST understates the decision's compound nature.

opportunities.learner_decision: Use thoracic point-of-care ultrasound, integrated with the clinical assessment, to evaluate suspected pneumothorax in an emergency presentation.
opportunities.justification: Point-of-care ultrasound for pneumothorax is a structural/anatomic imaging test (pleural sliding), directly on-axis.

opportunities.learner_decision: Recognize resolved episodic biliary pain as biliary colic and refer appropriate symptomatic patients for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy.
opportunities.justification: Referral for elective surgery is a disposition/referral decision, not acute operative source control (which the management_capability axis's operative tokens are built for); this is the single next step after diagnosis is recognized.

opportunities.learner_decision: Recognize postpartum psychosis as a psychiatric emergency and arrange urgent assessment to protect mother and infant.
opportunities.justification: Arranging urgent psychiatric assessment for a psychiatric emergency is the same escalation-of-care action class as RDY-MED-01, applied to a psychiatric rather than respiratory emergency.

independent_review.response_class_reason: ESCALATION_TO_CRITICAL_CARE literally denotes escalation to a medical critical-care unit; arranging urgent psychiatric assessment is urgent but not a critical-care-unit escalation. The axis's own generic token (NEXT_ACTION_FOR_CURRENT_CARE) may be the textually safer choice.

opportunities.learner_decision: Recognize schizophrenia from persistent psychotic symptoms with functional decline and distinguish shorter psychotic disorders by course.
opportunities.justification: cardinal_syndrome_capability has no token for primary psychotic disorders (its tokens are mood/systemic/structural syndromes); forcing PERSISTENT_MOOD_DISTURBANCE would be factually wrong since schizophrenia is not a mood disorder. Falls back honestly to the axis's own generic token (PLAUSIBLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ENTITY) rather than inventing a new one-off label, per the anti-hallucination contract.

opportunities.learner_decision: Classify risk-factor reduction before disease occurs as primary prevention, early detection as secondary prevention, and limitation of established disease effects as tertiary prevention.
opportunities.justification: Classifying an action into primary/secondary/tertiary prevention is a conceptual/epidemiologic classification, not a diagnosis, investigation, management, disposition, ethical or legal action; none of the 8 archetypes has a dedicated 'taxonomic classification' axis, so this falls back to the closest archetype (STATISTICAL_INTERPRETATION_SET) at its generic token. decision_granularity=EPIDEMIOLOGIC_EXPLANATION is an exact pre-existing match (this token was added to DECISION_GRANULARITIES specifically for population-health explanation decisions).

opportunities.learner_decision: Assess capacity for the specific proposed decision by determining whether the patient understands relevant information and foreseeable consequences.
opportunities.justification: Capacity assessment exists to determine whether a patient may exercise autonomous decision-making; AUTONOMY is the on-axis value served.
